source: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, county-wide downloads for every California county, read at the 2020 Census block internal points
licence: public domain (FEMA, a US government work)
measure: California's share of residents in a determined zone who are inside the SFHA (SFHA_TF = T): the anchor of the US flood scale (Bill, 2026-10-21). Read the way a city's share is: over the places (and each county's land outside every place) where FEMA has determined the risk for at least 95% of residents; a place over that is left out whole
